title: 5. Against: what dreams must not do

sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: A dream that rearranges the structure or promotes its own findings to authority undoes what it is for.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: Settled navigation should not completely rearrange itself (ac5974c6). Testimony becomes office only through a verification step (srs decision 16b20c56, Office over Testimony), so a dream's confidence must not by itself become authority. Decision c373c2c1 refuses any change that affirms or ratifies on the owner's behalf. srs-context's dreams merge their own changes because they touch only agent memory; the programme holds the owner's words and decisions, which no dream may rewrite.

sections.name: open
sections.label: Open
sections.content: Where the line falls between what a dream may change and what only the owner may: the third exercise.
